trigger.description: ee context --since was requested with a renderer that does not support delta envelopes in v1, so ee returns the full rendered pack and reports that the delta optimization was skipped.
setup_commands: ee remember 'Delta format unsupported fixture memory.' --workspace . --level procedural --kind fact --json
trigger.invocation: ee context 'delta format unsupported fixture' --workspace . --since <prior-pack-hash> --format markdown --json

expected_emission.repair_string: Use --format json or omit --since for markdown, TOON, Mermaid, handoff, and backup full-pack renderers.
